flags: wording: "Best Actor Oscar" is wrong. Heath Ledger won Best Supporting Actor (posthumously) for the Joker.
wording: "in 1998" is ambiguous. Shakespeare in Love was a 1998 film, but it won at the 1999 ceremony (71st Academy Awards).
wording: "his first Best Director Oscar" is false. Ang Lee's first Best Director Oscar was for Brokeback Mountain (2005). Life of Pi was his second.

wording: "first of its kind" is false. Beauty and the Beast (1991) was the first animated film nominated for Best Picture; Up was the second. The wording is also garbled: you can't "win" a nomination, and Up won Best Animated Feature at the same ceremony, not "later".
wording: The question includes a spoken self-correction ("pet dog... actually"). Delete the first part before reading it out.
wording: The Simpsons started in 1989, so it doesn't strictly fit a round on 1990s and 2000s sitcoms. It's also an animated sitcom.
wording: "what company does Dunder Mifflin sell" is wrong. Dunder Mifflin is itself the company, and it sells paper. The question should ask what Dunder Mifflin sells.
wording: Young Sheldon also features Sheldon Cooper, and The Big Bang Theory started in 2007.
